title: A finite algebra is integral
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a ring map of commutative rings making $B$ a finitely generated $A$-module. Then $B$ is integral over $A$: every $b\in B$ is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in (the image of) $A$.
